## Enrolment

* [Student and Campus Life Contribution (CVEC)](#) 

  In order to complete their administrative enrolment in a higher education institution, full degree students (who are not part of an exchange programme) will be asked to provide proof that they have paid the [Student and Campus Life Contribution (CVEC)](https://cvec.etudiant.gouv.fr/) or have been exonerated.

  You are exempt from paying the CVEC contribution if either of the following cases apply to you: you are a refugee who is in receipt of subsidiary protection, an asylum seeker with the right to stay in France, or a means-tested Crous grant holder.
* [Administrative enrolment](#) 

  Once you are accepted to study at Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne University, you will receive by email instructions on how to complete your administrative enrolment on Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne’s [Primoweb](https://primo.univ-paris1.fr/) website. You will receive a pre-enrolment number along with these instructions and a step-by-step tutorial. You will need your pre-enrolment number to access the Primoweb site, as well as your date of birth.

  For non-EU nationals, you can apply for a student visa using your enrolment letter if you live abroad, or request a renewal of your residence permit with this letter if you live in France.

  Once enrolled you will receive a confirmation printable email and your student number. Keep this number as it will allow you to activate your account on the ENT (virtual learning space) and access the university’s online services.

  On your ENT account you will find a tab entitled “Pièces Justificatives” where you should upload the documents required to complete your enrolment. These documents are:

  + **Identification document** (passport or national identity card)
  + **Academic of transcript** of secondary school qualifications along with a translation (also required for master’s courses)
  + **Proof of online payment** **of registration fees** (copy of this email)
  + **Proof of civil liability insurance**, which you can obtain from your relevant insurer (you can upload this later to the ENT).
* [Academic enrolment](#) 

  Once you have finished your administrative enrolment at the university you must proceed to complete your academic enrolment with your academic department. You must complete this step in order to be able to sit your examinations.

  Enrolment in language classes (eg. French as a foreign language), sport and cultural activities should be completed through the relevant services: the [Department of Languages (DDL)](https://www.pantheonsorbonne.fr/ufr/ddl/), [Sports and Physical Education Department (UEFAPS)](https://uefaps.univ-paris1.fr/) and the [Student Life Service (PVE)](https://www.pantheonsorbonne.fr/vie-etudiante).

## Grants

* [Eiffel Excellence Scholarship Programme (Master's level)](#) 

  The Eiffel Programme was established by the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs to help French institutions of higher education in their efforts to attract top foreign students to their master’s and doctoral programmes.

  Its purpose is to train future foreign decision-makers in the private and public sectors in priority areas of study and to attract to French institutions applicants from foreign countries at master’s level (up to 29 years old) and doctoral level (up to 35 years old).

  ### Eligibility

  + Apply for a *Master 1* (1st year of a Master's degree) or a *Master 2* (2nd year of a Master's degree) at Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne University in one of the following disciplines: history, law, political science, economics, management, ecological transition, mathematics and digital sciences.
  + Be a foreign citizen.
  + Be aged 29 or under at the time of the selection committee, i.e., born after 31st March 1996.
  + Have the required level of education to apply for the chosen programme.
  + Demonstrate a C1 level of proficiency in French, if French is not an official or administrative language in your home country.
  + Be a first-time applicant.
  + Applicants may not hold more than one scholarship.
  + Applicants currently studying in France are not eligible.

  ### Amount

  €1,200/month + round-trip travel expenses are covered.

  ### Duration

  12 months maximum for an admission in *Master 2* and 24 months maximum for an admission in *Master 1*.

  ### Application procedure

  + For detailed information about the application procedure and eligibility criteria, download the useful document at the bottom of this page.
  + The application deadline is **9th November 2025** (11:59pm Paris time).

  ### Contact

  [eiffel@univ-paris1.fr](mailto:eiffel@univ-paris1.fr "E-mail eiffel@univ-paris1.fr")

  For more information on the Eiffel Excellence Scholarship Programme, check the [Campus France website](https://www.campusfrance.org/fr/le-programme-de-bourses-d-excellence-eiffel).
